description: Public Utilities Commission of S/L Issuance of Certificate of Exemption S.L.A.M. Power Solutions (Pvt) Ltd
reasoning: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory notice issued by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (Amended). It involves the issuance of a Certificate of Exemption from licensing requirements for electricity distribution and supply, which constitutes a regulatory action under existing legislation. The content focuses on legal authority, regulatory compliance, and statutory exemptions rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
